# Rate-limit forgot-password and reset endpoints

## Summary

Add abuse-resistant rate limits on forgot-password submission and token validation / completion attempts per IP and/or email bucket, with responses that do not reveal whether an email is registered.

## Scope

- In scope: Middleware, edge config, or handler-level limiting consistent with Hermes dashboard deployment; documented limits for ops (PRD REQ-006); user-facing message on throttle that stays non-enumerating.
- Out of scope: DDoS at network edge (assume platform); SMS or other channels.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Forgot-password POST is rate-limited per PRD (IP and/or hashed email bucket—document choice).
- [ ] Reset completion attempts are limited sufficiently to slow brute-force of tokens (document thresholds).
- [ ] Throttled clients see a generic or retry-after style message without confirming account existence (REQ-006).
- [ ] Limits and behavior documented for operators (README, runbook, or dev-docs per team practice).

## Dependencies

- Depends on: TICKET-003, TICKET-004
- Blocks: none

## Notes

Coordinate with security review for exact numbers referenced in PRD §10.
